name: Queen Vashti
title: The Deposed Queen of Persia
summary: Vashti was queen of Persia, married to King Ahasuerus (Xerxes I). She was deposed after refusing to obey the king's command to appear before his guests at a banquet. Her removal paved the way for Esther to become queen.

keyEvents.title: Queen at Ahasuerus' Banquet
keyEvents.description: While King Ahasuerus held a grand feast for his officials and servants, Queen Vashti held a separate feast for the women in the royal palace.

keyEvents.title: Refuses to Obey the King's Command
keyEvents.description: When the king commanded that Vashti be brought before the guests wearing her royal crown to display her beauty, she refused to come.

keyEvents.title: The King's Advisors Give Counsel
keyEvents.description: The king's advisors, led by Memucan, warned that Vashti's disobedience might inspire other women in the kingdom to despise their husbands.

keyEvents.title: Deposition as Queen
keyEvents.description: King Ahasuerus issued a decree that Vashti should never again come before the king, and that her royal position should be given to someone better than she was.
